gap_details.2011-2012: No capture of the pmid=5799 residents page before 2012-10 in Wayback (CDX exact + prefix on bcm.edu/neurosurgery; 2010 captures are only contact/email variants). Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 has 13 old-host records, none the residents page. Reconstructed from alumni grads 2012-2018 at implied PGY (18 names). Not represented: Zheng Lan (PGY-1 would be implied by 2012-13 PGY-2 but he is neither bracketed nor an alumnus) and any 2011-12 leaver.
gap_details.2012-2013: Observed: Wayback 2012-10-12 (identical 2013-02-21), 'Last modified July 17, 2012'. Only 1 PGY-7 (Al-Hafez) - matches alumni 2013.
gap_details.2013-2014 .. 2017-2018: SIGNIFICANT. No roster capture at all: Wayback has nothing between 2013-02-21 (old site) and 2019-08-19 (new site residents page, which existed from 2015-10 per links but was never archived); old URLs 301 by 2016. Common Crawl pass 2013-2020 (edu,bcm)/departments/neurosurgery/education and edu,bcm)/neurosurgery, plus a wrapper for pmid URLs) found no residents page before 2019-01; CC-MAIN-2017-47 education prefix failed then retried OK (0 records). Reconstructed from alumni grads (entry = grad-7, consistent with 2012-13 / 2018-19 observations). Not represented: Zheng Lan (left sometime 2013-2018), Derek Lu (2016 entrant, PGY-1/2 in 2016-18), Venita Simpson (joined above PGY-1 on an unknown date). Any other unseen leaver/joiner in these 5 years is invisible.
gap_details.2018-2019: Observed via Common Crawl only (CC-MAIN-2019-04, 2019-01-16; also 2019-03-22 and 2019-05-20). Derek Lu PGY-3 in Jan, gone by Mar 2019; Patrick Cotton appears PGY-2 only in May 2019 (stored as a 1-row supplement).
gap_details.2019-2020: SIGNIFICANT (incomplete). Only capture (Wayback = CC-MAIN-2019-35, 2019-08-19) lists PGY-7..PGY-2; PGY-1 group absent (2019 entrants Sharma, Jackson, McGinnis, Snyder, seen as PGY-2 in 2020-21 and graduated 2026). Not reconstructed because the year has a usable capture. CC-MAIN-2019-39/43/47/51, 2020-05, 2020-16 (retried) had no residents page.
gap_details.2020-2021 .. 2026-2027: Observed each year, complete (7 PGY groups).
gap_details.2013-2014: Phase 2: OBSERVED. The ColdFusion site moved to www.bcm.edu/departments/neurosurgery/index.cfm (Wayback never captured it; phase 1 scanned only /departments/neurosurgery/education in CC). CC-MAIN-2014-10 and 2014-15 hold pmid=5799 (identical, 'Last modified July 09, 2013').
gap_details.2014-2015 .. 2017-2018: Phase 2: all CC crawls 2014-2018 rescanned with the wider prefixes edu,bcm)/departments/neurosurgery and edu,bcm)/neurosurgery (fixed filter + pmid wrapper; failed 2015-18 and 2017-13 retried OK). 2014-35..2015-06 have no BCM neurosurgery records; from 2015-03 the new-site /education/neurosurgery-residency page (linking /residents) is crawled ~monthly but /residents itself never is. Wayback gapaudit over bcm.edu/neurosurgery, /departments/neurosurgery, /education, /gme and surgery hosts: nothing new. Reconstruction kept, plus Lan 2014-15 PGY4 (PMID 25800940), Simpson 2015-16..2017-18 (PGY4-6; profile UUID created 2015-10-13), Lu 2016-17 PGY1 / 2017-18 PGY2 (PGY-3 Jan 2019, PMID 30230171).
